does_not_do: It has no importer for any particular broker built in and no graphical interface of its own (Fava provides one). It publishes versions to PyPI, not GitHub releases.
focus_reason: Holdings with cost lots can be tracked in plain text the owner controls, but every account must be modelled by hand or by importers the user writes. Last commit 2026-08-23.
measured_against: Need: track a household's holdings and transactions across accounts over time, self-hosted, from statements or exports the owner supplies.
tests_ci: Tests live beside the code; CI workflows run tests, linting and wheel builds.
what_it_is: A double-entry bookkeeping language: transactions are written in a text file, read into memory and reported on. Version 3 is the current stable line.
